title: Liquid Carat — Petite
subtitle: Round brilliants in a continuous line, moving with the wrist. No clasp, no closure.

stone.origin: Natural. No clasp — continuous flex setting.

description: The Liquid Carat™ in its most restrained form — round brilliant diamonds set in a continuous, no-clasp line that pours around the wrist and moves with it. There is no hinge and no closure; the stones simply flow, catching light in sequence as the hand turns. At the petite scale it reads as a fine, quiet thread of brilliance, easy to wear alone or layered. Bez Ambar built the Liquid Carat™ idea to make diamond behave like liquid, and this is where the series begins. Made to order.
